top_signals.title: Oil Declines as Saudi Arabia Moves to Restore Vital Pipeline
top_signals.summary: Oil fell on signs that supply disruptions in the Middle East are set to ease, with Saudi Arabia seeking to partially restore flows along a vital pipeline.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: The Forces Driving Mortgage Rates
top_signals.summary: With mortgage rates hovering around 7%.  Dynex Capital Co-CEO Smriti Popenoe joins Bloomberg Open Interest to explain why Treasury yields, government borrowing and hyperscaler debt are driving long-term rates—and outlines the Fed policy changes that could help unlock America’s frozen housing market. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Chelsea Owner Clearlake Capital Buys Out Boehly, Walter
top_signals.summary: Clearlake Capital agreed to buy out Chelsea Football Club chairman Todd Boehly and director Mark Walter, bringing an end to a turbulent period among the club’s owners. Randall Williams has more on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
